Last year's Cosmic Orange colour scheme for the iPhone 17 Pro was an instant hit when it was unveiled, but rumours suggest that the iPhone 18 Pro will switch to an all-new burgundy colour. Here's a preview based on the latest leaks.

Preview of the main new colour scheme for the iPhone 18 Pro

Apple has long adopted extremely understated colour schemes for its Pro iPhone models. However, the company made a major shift with the iPhone 17 Pro — moving beyond the confines of black and white to launch the eye-catching Cosmic Orange colour scheme, which immediately became a runaway hit.

Rumours suggest that the company plans to continue this bold design direction with the iPhone 18 Pro.

But instead of offering orange this time, Apple is expected to offer three (or possibly four) colour options:

  • Burgundy / Deep Cherry
  • Light Blue
  • Silver
  • Possibly Deep Grey

Whether a deep grey or black will be offered this year remains unconfirmed by rumours. However, there is stronger consensus on the other three colour options.

Among them, the Deep Cherry / Burgundy is expected to be the new flagship hero colour, and will serve as the focal point of Apple's marketing efforts.

Leaker Fixed Focus Digital posted on Weibo today, stating that he had seen both lighter and darker versions of the colour scheme online. However, he believes the correct tone should be the deeper variation — a purplish-red, cherry-like hue.

Some reports have simply referred to the colour as "red" or "dark red", which may explain why some dummy units have come across as lighter and more red-toned. But according to the leaker, what we will actually see is a purplish cherry tone.

What do you think of the rumoured hero colour for the iPhone 18 Pro? Let us know in the comments section.
